title: seperate widgets and "tray icons"
line: The System Tray now draws a thin line between app icons and Plasma's own system and hardware items.
explanation: The tray already sorts items by category (apps and communications first, then system services and hardware), but drew them as one undivided row, so app icons that open windows or menus blended into Plasma's widgets that open popups. Each item in the panel row now draws a thin widgets/line separator on its leading edge when its group (apps vs system/hardware) differs from the item before it. It follows the layout direction, reversed icon order and vertical panels, and is skipped when the tray wraps into a multi-row grid.

commits.message:
applets/systemtray: separate app icons from system items

App icons and Plasma's own tray items were drawn in one undivided row,
which made it hard to tell what clicking an icon would do. Draw a thin
line wherever the row moves between apps and system or hardware items.

BUG: 362077

patches.diff:
From 767919add9cc3094952207fac9d0a031d88ef660 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 23:08:37 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/systemtray: separate app icons from system items

App icons and Plasma's own tray items were drawn in one undivided row,
which made it hard to tell what clicking an icon would do. Draw a thin
line wherever the row moves between apps and system or hardware items.

BUG: 362077
---
 applets/systemtray/qml/main.qml | 16 ++++++++++++++++
 1 file changed, 16 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/systemtray/qml/main.qml b/applets/systemtray/qml/main.qml
index b5cb44ce79..7f49be4d1a 100644
--- a/applets/systemtray/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/systemtray/qml/main.qml
@@ -37,6 +37,10 @@ ContainmentItem {
 
     readonly property alias hiddenModel: hiddenModel
 
+    function isSystemCategory(category: string): bool {
+        return category === "SystemServices" || category === "Hardware";
+    }
+
     Component.onCompleted: {
         // We need all the plasmoiditems to be there for correct working of shortcuts.
         // Instantiators create the plasmoiditems: ensure this is done after
@@ -258,6 +262,18 @@ ContainmentItem {
                     width: tasksGrid.cellWidth
                     height: tasksGrid.cellHeight
 
+                    // Separate app icons from system services and hardware items
+                    KSvg.SvgItem {
+                        visible: root.oneRowOrColumn && delegate.index > 0
+                            && root.isSystemCategory(delegate.model.category) !== root.isSystemCategory(activeModel.data(activeModel.index(delegate.index - 1, 0), activeModel.KItemModels.KRoleNames.role("category")))
+                        imagePath: "widgets/line"
+                        elementId: root.vertical ? "horizontal-line" : "vertical-line"
+                        width: root.vertical ? tasksGrid.itemSize : 1
+                        height: root.vertical ? 1 : tasksGrid.itemSize
+                        x: root.vertical ? Math.round((parent.width - width) / 2) : (root.LayoutMirroring.enabled ? parent.width - width : 0)
+                        y: root.vertical ? (root.reverseLayout ? parent.height - height : 0) : Math.round((parent.height - height) / 2)
+                    }
+
                     // We need to recalculate the stacking order of the z values due to how keyboard navigation works
                     // the tab order depends exclusively from this, so we redo it as the position in the list
                     // ensuring tab navigation focuses the expected items
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: two app icons (Akregator, Yakuake) and a chat app (Konversation) run straight into the clipboard, volume, Bluetooth and other Plasma items
With the change: a thin line separates the app icons from Plasma's system and hardware items
